result.markdown: --- title: "Lessons from Mapping and evaluating dRTP’s contributions to computing skills and pedagogies in HE" subtitle: "Preliminary results" format: revealjs logo: /media/warwick-logo.svg footer: "https://tinyurl.com/DRTP-training" author: - name: "Carlos Cámara-Menoyo | Timothy Monteath | Lilly Horvath-Makkos" affiliation: Centre for Interdisciplinary Methodologies (University of Warwick) institute: "RSECon 2026 | Sheffield, 10th September 2026" theme: [default, ../../styles/warwick-slides.scss, ../../styles/warwick-fonts.scss] title-slide-attributes: data-background-image: media/RSE-25-0064.jpg # data-background-color: "#A499F4" data-background-color: "#5B0039" # data-background-size: contain data-background-opacity: "0.2" bibliography: references.bib --- # {.center .smaller background-color="#51D7C1"} ::::: columns ::: {.column width="50%"} ![](/media/carlos.png){fig-alt="Carlos Cámara" fig-align="center" width="250"} Dr. **Carlos Cámara-Menoyo** (PI) *Principal Research Software Engineer*, Centre for Interdisciplinary Methodologies (University of Warwick), [Institute for Research Software Fellow](https://software.ac.uk/) [carlos.camara\@warwick.ac.uk](mailto:carlos.camara@warwick.ac.uk){.email} [\@ccamara.scholar.social](https://scholar.social/@ccamara) [\@ccamara.scholar.social.ap.brid.gy](https://bsky.app/profile/ccamara.scholar.social.ap.brid.gy) ::: ::: {.column width="50%"} ![](/media/tim.png){fig-alt="Timothy Monteath" fig-align="center" width="250"} Dr.**Timothy Monteath** (Co-I) *Assistant Professor*, Centre for Interdisciplinary Methodologies (University of Warwick) [Timothy.monteath\@warwick.ac.uk](mailto:Timothy.monteath@warwick.ac.uk) {{< fa brands mastodon >}} [\@twm.mastodon.sdf.org](https://mastodon.sdf.org@twm) {{< fa brands bluesky >}} [\@twm.bsky.social](https://bsky.app/profile/twm.bsky.social) ::: ::::: ::: notes Hello, my name is Carlos Cámara, and I'll be presenting the work done with my colleague Tim Monteath. We both work at the Centre for Interdisciplinary Methodologies at the University of Warwick, me as a Principal RSE and Tim as an Assistant Professor and Lilly Horvath Makkos who has been working with us as a Research Assistant. ::: # The challenge: training DRCs {.smaller .center} ::::: columns ::: {.column width="60%"} We are seeing a **computational turn in research**, as seen in a - growing number of research that relies on **data** or **research software** [@crouch2013], - adoption of **computational methods** by fields that didn't traditionally use them (e.g. computational social sciences, digital humanities...) - growing importance of **OpenScience** and expectation to manage data and outputs following **FAIR principles**, - growing number of infrastructure and professionals needed for its delivery, - the advent of AI (adding a new level of complexity). This **requires a broad set of skills -[Digital Research Competencies(DRC)]{.highlight-text}-** that need to be [learnt]{.highlight-text} and [taught]{.highlight-text}. ::: ::: {.column width="40%"} ![[DIRECT Framework](https://directframework.com/) [@nenadic2026]](/media/DIRECT%20Framework_alpha.png) ::: ::::: ::: notes Research is becoming increasingly computational, as seen in This requires a broad set skills -Digital Research Competencies- that need to be learnt and taught. DIRECT framework acknowledges the importance and diversity of training and Digital Research Competencies, but it does not explain some of the questions that we were having... ::: # So we wondered... ::::: columns ::: {.column width="60%"} - If training is needed, and RSEs are not doing it, [who are the professionals filling this gap]{.highlight-text}? - If multiple professionals are doing it: [does the]{.highlight-text} [training differ based on their backgrounds?]{.highlight-text} - And more broadly: how are DRC being delivered and what are their [key defining]{.highlight-text} [factors]{.highlight-text}? ::: ::: {.column width="40%"} ![[RSE International Survey](https://rse-survey.soton.ac.uk/superset/dashboard/RSE_survey/) [@HettrickRSESurveylongitudinal2026] (results from 2022 and UK only)](/media/RSE-survey_UK_2022_what-are-you-spending-your-time-on-2026-06-18T11-18-14.266Z.jpg) ::: ::::: ::: notes For example, after seeing the RSE international Survey, and how training was tangential to RSEs, we wondered... ::: # Our research {.smaller background-color="#DAD6CA"} ***"Mapping and evaluating dRTP’s contributions to computing skills and pedagogies in Higher Education"*** **is a project funded by the UKRI's [DisCouRSE Network+](https://discourse-network.github.io/) and [aims to map and analyse the provision of digital research]{.highlight-text} [competencies (DRC)]{.highlight-text} which are led by or involve dRTP’s across Higher Education institutions in the UK.** ::::: {.columns .smaller} ::: {.column width="70%"} The research acknowledges and complements existing competency frameworks like DIRECT but [examines the role played by the professionals and the material]{.highlight-text} [conditions of training delivery]{.highlight-text} instead of learning needs. **Research questions include:** - How are dRTPs engaging in the teaching of Digital Research Competencies? - What are the methodologies and technologies used to deliver the training? How are decisions on training delivery made? - How is the training influenced by matters such as type of professional, career stage, background, pedagogical approaches, trends, availability, licences or teachers’ beliefs? - Are there any approaches that are more frequently used for specific audiences or cases? ::: ::: {.column width="30%"} ![](/media/DisCouRSE-Logo-Light.svg){width="400"} [This work was supported by the [DisCouRSE Network+](https://discourse-network.github.io/), which received funding through the UKRI Digital Research Infrastructure Programme]{.caption} ::: ::::: ::: notes The research acknowledges and complements existing competency frameworks like DIRECT but examines the role played by the professionals and the material conditions of training delivery instead on learning needs. ::: # Methodology {background-color="#A499F4"} ## Survey {.smaller} ::::: columns ::: {.column width="70%"} **People** - Who are involved? What are their job titles? - How are they involved in the teaching? - Do they have any [pedagogical background]{.highlight-text}? - What are their [beliefs]{.highlight-text} in relation to tech and pedagogy? *(e.g. stance as a teacher, importance of opensource, AI, licences...)* **Training and pedagogies** - What is being taught? - What [formats]{.highlight-text} and [delivery mode]{.highlight-text} are used? - What are the [key factors]{.highlight-text} influencing how the training is delivered? - Infrastructure needed - Challenges ::: ::: {.column width="30%"} ![Link to the survey: ](media/qualtrics-qrcode.png) EXPLAIN WHERE THE SURVEY WAS DISTRIBUTED TO ::: ::::: ## Systematic analysis {.center} - Computationally [map every dRTP's across UK HE]{.highlight-text} via web-scraping - Capture dRTP role descriptions and involvement in training/teaching - Data to supplement qualitative research; - Designed to provide a broad overview of sector wide trends - However, not comprehensive! Many dRTP's and their involvement in teach/training not on university webpages/publicly available ## Systematic analysis methods {.centre} - First attempt; use [CommonCrawl](https://commoncrawl.or)[^1] as an archive of university webpages - Roadblock, CommonCrawl was nowhere near comprehensive enough for this task! - Currently running; - Custom web scraper (*politely*[^2]) works through all webpages (branching of homepage) of each UK university - Raw HTML is filtered for any potentially relevant content - Cleaned HTML passed to LLM and transformed into structured data [^1]: Common Crawl maintains a free, open repository of web crawl data that can be used by anyone, consisting of **over 300 billion pages spanning 19 years**. [^2]: Polite's pillars: seeking permission, taking slowly and never asking twice. ::: notes Common Crawl maintains a free, open repository of web crawl data that can be used by anyone. ::: # Preliminary Results {background-color="#A499F4"} ::: {.cell} ::: ::: {.cell} ::: # Survey (I) About professionals involved in teaching ## Professional categories distributions What are the DRTPs professions involved in teaching? ::: {.cell} ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](index_files/figure-revealjs/unnamed-chunk-1-1.png){width=960} ::: ::: ## Pedagogical backgrounds {.smaller} ::: {.cell layout="[60,40]" layout-ncol="2"} ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](index_files/figure-revealjs/unnamed-chunk-2-1.png){width=960} ::: ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](index_files/figure-revealjs/unnamed-chunk-2-2.png){width=960} ::: ::: - dRTPs have received extensive HE training - dRTPs are largely trained to be technical trainers (carpentries), but - Significant amount of them have not received any training in pedagogy or training Digital Research Competencies - Only a fraction have significant training on pedagogy (pgCERT, FHEA). - **dRTPs are experts in their domains and Digital Research Competencies, but not necessarily on teaching/pedagogy** ## Stances in relation to tech and pedagogy ::: {.cell} ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](index_files/figure-revealjs/unnamed-chunk-3-1.png){width=960} ::: ::: # Survey (II) {.smaller} About trainings ## What's being taught ::: {.cell} ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](index_files/figure-revealjs/unnamed-chunk-4-1.png){width=960} ::: ::: ## {data-menu="DIRECT Framework Competencies"} According to DIRECT Framework ::: {.cell} ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](index_files/figure-revealjs/unnamed-chunk-5-1.png){width=960} ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ::: ## Audience ::: {.cell} ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](index_files/figure-revealjs/unnamed-chunk-7-1.png){width=960} ::: ::: ## How's being taught? Maybe because of lack of pedagogical training... (consider creating a narrative in the slides) ::: {.cell} ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](index_files/figure-revealjs/unnamed-chunk-8-1.png){width=960} ::: ::: ::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"} - Part of a degree curricula (either UG or PG), separating between core or optional modules. - Formal (e.g. compulsory training for a job such as accessing HPC services). - Informal: any course or workshop not fiting in any previous category. ::: ## How are DRTPs involved in the teaching? ::: {.cell} ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](index_files/figure-revealjs/unnamed-chunk-9-1.png){width=960} ::: ::: ------------------------------------------------------------------------ ::: {.cell} ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](index_files/figure-revealjs/unnamed-chunk-10-1.png){width=960} ::: ::: - dRTPs lead on informal training - dRTPs are less involved in degree's curricula, and when they are, they tend to have a supporting role ------------------------------------------------------------------------ ::: {.cell} ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](index_files/figure-revealjs/unnamed-chunk-11-1.png){width=960} ::: ::: ## Infrastructure used ::: {.cell} ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](index_files/figure-revealjs/unnamed-chunk-12-1.png){width=960} ::: ::: ## But... {.center data-menu="But..." background-color="#F1977F"} [Only 39 valid responses and 44 trainings.]{.r-fit-text} [Results are not representative]{.r-fit-text} [**We need your help!**]{.r-fit-text} ## Fill in (and share) the survey It won't take more than 10' and would mean a lot to us. ![](media/qualtrics-qrcode.png){alt="Link to the survey: https://tinyurl.com/DRTP-training-survey" fig-align="center" width="200"} Link to the survey: []{.r-fit-text} # Systematic audit results - Pilot at all University of Warwick's website: - Dataset: - 135 Professionals scrapped - fields: `name`, `job title`, `activities` (including trainings), `projects`, `funding sources` - Currently evaluating - Clean and parse systematic analysis results - Estimate accuracy of results by comparing them against human classified data (University of Warwick) - List of every HE and Research organisations in the UK's URLs for scraping. # Next Steps Aim for more responses to the survey + deeper analyses (combining questions) Open repository using FAIR principles, containing: - datasets (survey and systematic mapping) - report to Inform decision-making processes about designing and delivering training # Thanks! {background-color="#A499F4"} (and please, fill in the survey!) ## References

<script>
  // htmlwidgets need to know to resize themselves when slides are shown/hidden.
  // Fire the "slideenter" event (handled by htmlwidgets.js) when the current
  // slide changes (different for each slide format).
  (function () {
    // dispatch for htmlwidgets
    function fireSlideEnter() {
      const event = window.document.createEvent("Event");
      event.initEvent("slideenter", true, true);
      window.document.dispatchEvent(event);
    }

    function fireSlideChanged(previousSlide, currentSlide) {
      fireSlideEnter();

      // dispatch for shiny
      if (window.jQuery) {
        if (previousSlide) {
          window.jQuery(previousSlide).trigger("hidden");
        }
        if (currentSlide) {
          window.jQuery(currentSlide).trigger("shown");
        }
      }
    }

    // hookup for slidy
    if (window.w3c_slidy) {
      window.w3c_slidy.add_observer(function (slide_num) {
        // slide_num starts at position 1
        fireSlideChanged(null, w3c_slidy.slides[slide_num - 1]);
      });
    }

  })();
</script>
